verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own docs say customers can be screened against a global database that includes Politically Exposed Persons registers, and screening hits feed into case review via the web app or API. The pack never mentions relatives or close associates of PEPs, and never shows source context or provenance attached to a PEP hit. Missing for 10: documented detection of related associates, supporting source context for PEP matches, and independent or hands-on corroboration of PEP screening quality.
